title: Skate Session Airtime and Trick Count
dataSources: E-bike rides (`ebike:ride`), scooter trips (`scooter:trip`), skate sessions (`skate:session`), surf sessions (`surf:session`), snow runs (`snow:run`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sport trackers — e-bike / e-scooter apps (VanMoof, Bosch eBike Flow), and skate / surf / snow session trackers (Trace, Slopes, Xensr) with IMU sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=skate:session
| stats sum(tricks_landed) as tricks, max(max_airtime_ms) as best_air, sum(duration_min) as minutes by session
| eventstats avg(tricks) as avg_tricks
| sort - _time
description: Tracks tricks landed and best airtime per skate session from a board-mounted motion sensor.
value: Objective session stats turn practice into visible progress and help you chase a new personal airtime record.
implementation: Ingest skate IMU sessions into `index=personal`; review tricks and airtime per session.
visualization: Table of skate sessions with tricks and best airtime.
grandmaExplanation: It counts your tricks and measures your biggest jumps each skate session, so you can see yourself improve.
